snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: Get ready to scrub, spray, and shine in PowerWash Simulator 2! Launching on October 23, 2025, this sequel brings a fresh wave of satisfying cleaning action to your screen. Dive into a new campaign set in the vibrant Caldera County, featuring multi‑stage levels, a customizable home base, and the ability to pet cats. With new tools like the adaptable nozzle, scissor lift, and SwirlForce floor cleaner, your power‑washing experience is more immersive than ever. Enjoy split‑screen co‑op and online multiplayer modes, and tackle grime solo or with friends across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
